title: Launch sync (Morgan, Jamie, Pat)
objective: Align engineering and marketing on the launch timeline and assign clear action items.
expect: Timeline conflict: campaign live Nov 15 but build only deployed and tested by Nov 18
Unassigned task: 'update the sandbox API keys' has no owner: ask who owns it
Agenda drift: v2.0 UI colour debate during the v1.0 launch sync: park it

utterances.text: Alright team, let's look at the launch schedule. Jamie, where are we with the final staging deployment?
We ran into some bugs with the payment gateway over the weekend. We're working through them now. I'm confident we will have the final build deployed to staging and fully tested by November 18th.
utterances.speaker: A

utterances.text: That sounds good. On the marketing side, the email sequences and ad spend are all locked in. The campaign goes live on November 15th, and we expect heavy traffic right away.
utterances.speaker: B

utterances.text: Excellent, glad to hear marketing is ready to go. What's the next step for the beta testers?
Before the beta testers get in, someone really needs to update the sandbox API keys so they don't hit the production database. If that doesn't happen, we're going to have messy data.
utterances.speaker: A

utterances.text: Good call. We definitely don't want them messing up the live metrics.
utterances.speaker: B

utterances.text: Agreed, let's make sure the sandbox keys are updated. Now, moving on to the post-launch retrospective...

Wait, for the retrospective, are we going to talk about the v2.0 UI overhaul? Because I really think we should change the primary color scheme to blue. Our competitors are using green, and blue converts better.
utterances.speaker: B

utterances.text: I disagree, changing the UI will take at least three weeks of front-end work, and we already have a backlog of bug fixes.
utterances.speaker: A

utterances.text: Yeah, the color scheme is tricky. What if we did an A/B test on just the landing page?
